description.from:
As a household member, I want writing bot memory after a Front Door recycle to load the bot from DynamoDB, so POST /bots/{id}/memory does not KeyError on an empty in-process roster.

Feature: Shared computer and isolated bot memory

Scenario: Bot memory can be written after a recycled control plane
  Given an empty control plane backed by a durable messaging store
  And tenant "anthus" user "ryan" has a bot named "Researcher"
  When the control plane is recycled onto the same messaging store
  And bot "Researcher" remembers "voice" as "short and direct"
  Then the turn prompt contains memory "voice" as "short and direct"

Wait, turn prompt needs a channel/turn. Better:

Scenario: Bot memory can be written after a recycled control plane
  Given an empty control plane backed by a durable messaging store
  And tenant "anthus" user "ryan" has a channel with a named bot "Researcher"
  When the control plane is recycled onto the same messaging store
  And bot "Researcher" remembers "voice" as "short and direct"
  Then bot "Researcher" still remembers "voice" as "short and direct"

Need a then that reads memory via plane.memory after hydrate.

Not included: staging, production, Fargate, Safari.
